pages.title: Well-Ordering Charm
pages.text: A pendant of nested rings, each smaller than the one before, with no ring missing and none endless. It embodies the well-ordering principle: every non-empty set of ordinals has a least element, so every descending chain must stop. In a place full of infinities, it is comforting to wear a guarantee of a bottom.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Transfinite Hierarchy kept dropping me into staircases that went down forever. I set a surreal number inside rings cut from a power set and an aleph-null shard, and the charm forced every descent to end. I have not fallen forever since.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.
